rows.en: For a member's act in a project that has its own AI account, that project's account pays. Otherwise the member's own account, if they connected one; otherwise the team's key. The account chosen is the one used: if it has reached a limit, or that use is switched off on it, the assistant stops for that act and says whose setting stopped it.
rows.cut: For a member's act in a project that has its own AI account, that project's account pays. Otherwise the member's own account, if they connected one; otherwise the group's key. The account chosen is the one used: if it has reached a limit, or that use is switched off on it, the assistant stops for that act and says whose setting stopped it.

rows.en: Everything else works: searching, counting and your team's templates take the assistant's place. If you think this should change, ask an administrator.
rows.cut: Everything else works: searching, counting and your group's templates take the assistant's place. If you think this should change, ask an administrator.

rows.en: If you disconnect it, the team's API key serves you instead.
rows.cut: If you disconnect it, the group's API key serves you instead.

rows.en: The assistant serves you on the team's API key.
rows.cut: The assistant serves you on the group's API key.

rows.en: The team pays, up to {limit} for each member, a limit your administrators set.
rows.cut: The group pays, up to {limit} for each member, a limit your administrators set.

rows.en: The assistant isn't serving you yet. Your team doesn't pay for the assistant; if you want it, connect your own account below, or skip it.
rows.cut: The assistant isn't serving you yet. Your group doesn't pay for the assistant; if you want it, connect your own account below, or skip it.

rows.en: Your questions, and the material read to answer them, go to Anthropic under the team's account. Administrators see how much the team's key is used in total, never what you ask or who asked.
rows.cut: Your questions, and the material read to answer them, go to Anthropic under the group's account. Administrators see how much the group's key is used in total, never what you ask or who asked.

rows.en: Open Anthropic's sign-in page. It opens in a new tab: Anthropic's own page, not your team's Civicsmith.
rows.cut: Open Anthropic's sign-in page. It opens in a new tab: Anthropic's own page, not your group's Civicsmith.

rows.en: Your team's Civicsmith never sees your Claude password, and the code is used once and never kept. Your subscription then serves only your own questions, and you can disconnect at any time. Needs a Pro or Max plan, and your team's Civicsmith on Workers Paid.
rows.cut: Your group's Civicsmith never sees your Claude password, and the code is used once and never kept. Your subscription then serves only your own questions, and you can disconnect at any time. Needs a Pro or Max plan, and your group's Civicsmith on Workers Paid.

rows.en: Your team's Civicsmith couldn't check your sign-in just now, so it can't say whether your subscription is connected. Open this page again in a moment.
rows.cut: Your group's Civicsmith couldn't check your sign-in just now, so it can't say whether your subscription is connected. Open this page again in a moment.

rows.en: In your web browser: go to console.anthropic.com, sign in, add a payment method, then API keys › Create key, and paste it here. Anthropic bills you for each use. Your team's Civicsmith keeps it sealed, never shows or exports it, and uses it only for your questions.
rows.cut: In your web browser: go to console.anthropic.com, sign in, add a payment method, then API keys › Create key, and paste it here. Anthropic bills you for each use. Your group's Civicsmith keeps it sealed, never shows or exports it, and uses it only for your questions.

rows.en: Or skip it: everything in your team's Civicsmith works without the assistant, and you can connect later.
rows.cut: Or skip it: everything in your group's Civicsmith works without the assistant, and you can connect later.

rows.en: On the team's key, your administrators set what it pays for and its limits. Today: at most {limit} for each member. If they change either, this shows the new setting.
rows.cut: On the group's key, your administrators set what it pays for and its limits. Today: at most {limit} for each member. If they change either, this shows the new setting.

rows.en: Signing in with a subscription isn't set up on your team's Civicsmith yet. You can connect an API key instead.
rows.cut: Signing in with a subscription isn't set up on your group's Civicsmith yet. You can connect an API key instead.

rows.cut: The part of your group's Civicsmith that signs you in didn't answer in time. Try again in a moment.

rows.en: The assistant's part of your team's Civicsmith didn't answer in time. Try again in a moment.
rows.cut: The assistant's part of your group's Civicsmith didn't answer in time. Try again in a moment.

rows.en: Your subscription shows as connected, but your team's Civicsmith no longer holds the sign-in. Connect again.
rows.cut: Your subscription shows as connected, but your group's Civicsmith no longer holds the sign-in. Connect again.

rows.en: Anthropic's side didn't confirm the sign-out. Your team's Civicsmith no longer uses it; try again to be sure.
rows.cut: Anthropic's side didn't confirm the sign-out. Your group's Civicsmith no longer uses it; try again to be sure.

rows.en: Your team keeps its material away from AI, so no account can be connected. If you think this should change, ask an administrator.
rows.cut: Your group keeps its material away from AI, so no account can be connected. If you think this should change, ask an administrator.

rows.cut: Outward · leaves your group's Civicsmith

rows.en: If you connect your own account, it serves you instead of the team's key, and only you.
rows.cut: If you connect your own account, it serves you instead of the group's key, and only you.

rows.en: Your limits bind only your own account; the team's and a project's limits never bind it. With no limit, nothing is capped here except Anthropic's own spending limit on your key. The first time a limit is reached in a period, you are told once in your queue.
rows.cut: Your limits bind only your own account; the group's and a project's limits never bind it. With no limit, nothing is capped here except Anthropic's own spending limit on your key. The first time a limit is reached in a period, you are told once in your queue.
